name: bricks/set-page-elements
label: Set page elements
description: Replace the entire element tree on a page or template. Destructive: every existing element is overwritten. A pre-save revision is captured automatically; pass the returned `revisionId` to `bricks/restore-revision` to undo. Granular alternatives: `bricks/add-element`, `bricks/update-element`, `bricks/remove-element`.

postId.description: Post, page, or template ID. The primary identifier; prefer this whenever it is known.

path.description: Hierarchical path like "parent/child". Alternative to postId for nested pages.

title.description: Exact post title. Alternative to `postId`; ambiguous when multiple posts share the same title.

elements.description: Element objects, not JSON strings. Accepts nested {name, children} format or flat Bricks format. Element `id` is the internal 6-character Bricks ID used by builder references and the default frontend selector `#brxe-{id}`. In nested format, you may omit `id` and Bricks generates ids while preserving parent-child nesting. In flat format, ids and parent references must be valid 6-character ids.

expectedDocumentDigest.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency precondition. Pass a SHA-256 document digest returned by a preview workflow; the save is rejected if the current Bricks tree changed before commit.

revisionId.description: Revision ID of the snapshot taken before this save. Pass to bricks/restore-revision to roll back. Null if the page had no prior content.

documentDigest.description: SHA-256 digest of the saved normalized element tree.
